title: Milestone 3: lossless snapshots and rebuildable cloud catalog
description: Make backend choice reversible without data loss. Preserve raw issue fields, full IDs, relations, comments, ordering, timestamps, events/history and configuration in versioned hashed snapshots. Canonical S3 records must export to the local file representation without catalog-only data loss. Define identical duplicate no-op versus conflicting duplicate rejection explicitly. Rebuild DynamoDB directly from normal canonical S3 files, verifying pointers and hashes. S3 export is a simple canonical-prefix copy; import copies normal files then rebuilds the catalog. Auxiliary repair state must not appear in the canonical prefix. Git remains a valid primary filesystem workflow; JSON snapshots do not claim to preserve Git commit ancestry. Done when real large-history fixtures and round-trip/failure/duplicate tests pass.
